subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: When one supported Antigravity model-family quota is exhausted but another remains usable, should automatic compact display and merged highest-usage selection surface the exhausted family or preserve the existing usable-lane preference?
rationale: The current tests deliberately define usable-lane preference, while the proposed exhausted-first behavior is also plausible for exposing the blocking reset; source inspection cannot determine the intended product policy.

options.title: Use context-specific selection
options.body: Surface exhausted windows for reset-focused presentation while retaining usable-lane selection for actionable percentage and highest-usage views.

options.title: Always prioritize exhausted
options.body: Accept the PR's policy so any exhausted supported Antigravity family wins automatic display and ranking until reset.

options.title: Preserve usable preference
options.body: Keep the existing behavior and redesign or close the PR without reversing the automatic default.

recommendation.title: Use context-specific selection
recommendation.body: Surface exhausted windows for reset-focused presentation while retaining usable-lane selection for actionable percentage and highest-usage views.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available authority for choosing the permanent user-visible automatic-selection contract.
